replies.author: i-am-groo0oot

replies.author: i-am-groo0oot
replies.body:
How I made it: the whole thing was made in Beeloop Engine, and that was my workflow from start to finish. First I wrote the game document: the story, the levels, and how each giant works in the puzzles. Then I wrote each character, Kip and every giant, with a description of what they look like. I generated their images in the engine from those descriptions. The engine's AI (Claude) built the game from the document.

workflow process: [https://imgur.com/a/1znJ0yl](https://imgur.com/a/1znJ0yl)

The hardest part was keeping it difficult but still fun. That meant writing each puzzle out myself, which giant goes where and in what order, so the AI had something solid to build. Without that it would just make something easy or something that doesn't make sense.
